authors: Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team, University of Macau, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Guozhi Zhan 等 (23 人)
abstract: Scaling generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies is severely bottlenecked by the inherent heterogeneity of embodied data, which spans diverse robot morphologies, camera configurations, and low-level action spaces. Existing paradigms typically address this mismatch through explicit action retargeting, human-to-robot video synthesis, or dataset-specific adaptation branches, fundamentally hindering the joint learning of a unified policy. We introduce UCAG-P, a camera-centric unified action formulation that structurally aligns heterogeneous embodied datasets into a shared geometric action space. Rather than treating robot-specific commands as the shared policy target, UCAG-P represents manipulation through camera-observable anchor motion in image and camera-frame coordinates, treating robot arms, humanoids, and human hands as different embodiments of a common action schema. A geometry-conditioned action translator combines predicted motion with target-embodiment kinematics to produce executable controls. The resulting decoupled architecture allows a shared VLA policy to learn transferable manipulation geometry while retaining embodiment-specific controllability. UCAG-P is trained on 4.03K hours of robot and simulation data and 2.34K hours of human demonstrations. A single checkpoint reaches 98.3% on LIBERO, 88.7% and 89.2% on RoboTwin Easy and Hard, 82.0% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus, and 62.0% on RoboCasa GR-1, without benchmark-specific fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的规模化落地受到具身数据固有异构性的严重瓶颈制约，这类数据覆盖了形态各异的机器人本体、相机配置与底层动作空间。现有范式通常通过显式动作重定向、人-机器人视频合成或数据集专属适配分支来解决该不匹配问题，从根本上阻碍了统一策略的联合学习。本文提出UCAG-P（以相机为中心的统一动作预训练框架），这一以相机为核心的统一动作范式可将异构具身数据集在结构上对齐至共享几何动作空间。UCAG-P并未将机器人专属指令作为共享策略的训练目标，而是通过图像与相机坐标系下可被相机观测到的锚点运动来表征操作行为，将机械臂、人形机器人与人手视为同一通用动作模式的不同具身形态。结合几何条件动作转换器，可将预测运动与目标具身的运动学特征相结合，生成可执行控制指令。最终得到的解耦架构可让共享VLA策略学习可迁移的操作几何特征，同时保留不同具身的专属可控性。UCAG-P在4.03K小时的机器人与仿真数据、2.34K小时的人类演示数据上完成训练，无需针对基准测试集进行微调，单模型检查点即可在LIBERO基准上达到98.3%的准确率，在RoboTwin简单、困难子集上分别达到88.7%与89.2%的准确率，在LIBERO-Plus零样本任务上达到82.0%的准确率，在RoboCasa GR-1任务上达到62.0%的准确率。

title: $R^3$: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: R³：通过强化学习训练机器人实现自然语言推理
authors: Lehong Wu, Yuxiao Qu, Zheyuan Hu, Ivan Zhang, Limin Wei 等 (7 人)
abstract: Reasoning in language allows foundation models to spend more test-time compute on hard problems, such as those requiring decomposition, constraint tracking, and prediction of future consequences. Whether this mechanism can improve robotic manipulation remains unclear, where long-horizon tasks require tracking partial progress, reasoning about object relations, recovering from mistakes, and steering noisy low-level policies. In this paper, we study whether VLMs can be trained to reason directly in natural language to guide low-level manipulation policies. We introduce $R^3$, a simple post-training recipe that turns off-the-shelf VLMs into robotic reasoners: it first mid-trains a VLM on expert-generated reasoning traces to initialize the desired reasoning style, then improves the reasoner with single-step rubric-based RL from offline action data. Unlike prior robotic reasoning methods that mostly use structured traces as auxiliary supervision, $R^3$ trains free-form language reasoning to produce test-time guidance for action. We instantiate $R^3$ on Language Table and simulated bimanual grocery packing, two controlled testbeds for studying robotic reasoning and long-horizon manipulation. $R^3$ improves exploration and generalization across unseen tasks and significantly outperforms instruction-only imitation learning baselines on both benchmarks. Our analyses suggest that free-form language reasoning can function as a test-time compute mechanism for steering low-level policies. Our project page is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 语言推理能力可让基础模型在测试阶段为复杂问题分配更多计算资源，这类复杂问题通常包含任务分解、约束跟踪与未来后果预测等需求。目前尚不清楚该机制能否提升机器人操作性能，长周期机器人任务需要跟踪部分进度、推理物体间关系、从错误中恢复并引导存在噪声的底层策略。本文研究能否训练视觉语言模型（VLM）直接通过自然语言推理来引导底层操作策略。本文提出R³，一种简单的后训练方案，可将现有商用VLM转化为机器人推理器：首先在专家生成的推理轨迹上对VLM进行中期训练，初始化目标推理风格，随后基于离线动作数据，采用单步基于评分标准的强化学习进一步优化推理器。与现有大多将结构化轨迹作为辅助监督的机器人推理方法不同，R³训练自由形式的语言推理能力，为动作生成测试阶段的引导信号。本文在Language Table平台与仿真双臂杂货打包任务两个用于研究机器人推理与长周期操作的受控测试平台上实例化R³框架。R³提升了模型在未见任务上的探索能力与泛化性能，在两个基准测试上的表现均显著优于仅基于指令的模仿学习基线。分析结果表明，自由形式的语言推理可作为测试阶段的计算机制，用于引导底层策略。项目主页可访问对应链接获取。

title: When Obstacles Bend: Modeling Vegetation Deformation in the context of Field Robotics
title_zh: 障碍物形变场景下的野外机器人植被变形建模
authors: Muhammad Hsaeeb Zaar Khizar, Tom Montagnon, Roland Lenain, Romuald Aufrère, Johann Laconte
abstract: Autonomous robots operating in natural environments must often interact with vegetation rather than simply avoid it. In this context, traversability is typically defined from the robot's perspective, by measuring how a specific platform responds when moving through the environment. While practical, this viewpoint entangles the assessment of the environment with the robot's own dynamics, making the resulting characterization difficult to transfer across different platforms. More importantly, it does not directly reflect the properties of the vegetation itself, which are the true source of interaction and potential damage in applications such as agriculture and environmental monitoring. To address this limitation, we propose to characterize vegetation through its intrinsic mechanical properties, independently of any specific robot. By combining deformation measurements with contact force data, we estimate the underlying mechanical parameters and reconstruct the vegetation's response to interaction. This enables vegetation-aware navigation based on intrinsic environmental properties rather than platform-dependent metrics.
summary_zh: 在自然环境中运行的自主机器人通常需要与植被交互，而非单纯避开植被。该场景下的可通行性通常从机器人视角定义，通过测量特定平台在环境中移动时的响应得到。该视角虽然具备实用性，但将环境评估与机器人自身动力学特性耦合，导致得到的特征难以在不同平台间迁移。更重要的是，该视角无法直接反映植被本身的属性，而植被属性才是农业、环境监测等应用中交互行为与潜在损伤的真正来源。为解决该局限，本文提出独立于任何特定机器人，通过植被的固有力学属性对其进行表征。通过结合形变测量结果与接触力数据，估算底层力学参数，重建植被对交互行为的响应，最终实现基于环境固有属性、而非依赖平台指标的植被感知导航。

title: Phantom Navigator: Stealthy and Precise Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Redirection with Real-Time Tracking and GPS Spoofing
title_zh: Phantom Navigator（幻影导航者）：结合实时跟踪与GPS欺骗的隐蔽精准无人机重定向技术
authors: Haocheng Meng, Shaocheng Luo, Songqiao Xie, Miroslav Pajic
abstract: Redirecting unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) from their intended mission trajectories has been an active area of research. However, existing UAV redirection attacks lack reliability, precision, and covertness for a targeted diversion. They primarily rely on physical capture, communication hijacking, or sensor spoofing. Yet, physical interception is costly, offers only a single opportunity for success, and poses a high risk of collateral damage; network-based attacks demand deep technical expertise and access to encrypted communication channels; and sensor spoofing techniques typically fall short in achieving the accuracy and robustness required to steer a UAV toward a specified target. Consequently, we propose Phantom Navigator, a UAV redirection attack to mislead drones to a designated spoofing target, covertly and precisely. Our approach combines offline pre-redirection reachability analysis, which provides high-fidelity estimates of achievable redirect ranges, with an online closed-loop, stealthy execution layer that ensures successful redirection in practice. Based on this approach, we build a physical attack platform equipped with a LiDAR--camera detection, tracking, and spoofing stack that performs real-time identification, pose estimation, and computation of targeted spoofing signals to covertly and accurately redirect victim UAVs to a designated location. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our redirection methodology and the attack implementation in real-world case studies.
summary_zh: 将无人机（UAV）从预设任务轨迹重定向是当前的活跃研究领域。但现有无人机重定向攻击在定向诱导场景下缺乏可靠性、精度与隐蔽性，这类攻击主要依赖物理捕获、通信劫持或传感器欺骗手段。其中物理拦截成本高，仅存在一次成功机会，且附带损伤风险高；基于网络的攻击需要极高的技术门槛，且需要接入加密通信信道；传感器欺骗技术通常难以达到引导无人机飞向指定目标所需的精度与鲁棒性。据此本文提出Phantom Navigator（幻影导航者），一种可隐蔽、精准诱导无人机飞向指定欺骗目标的重定向攻击方法。该方法将离线重定向前可达性分析与在线闭环隐蔽执行层相结合，前者可对可实现的重定向范围进行高保真估计，后者可保障实际场景下重定向的成功率。基于该方法，本文搭建了实体攻击平台，集成激光雷达-相机检测、跟踪与欺骗栈，可完成实时识别、位姿估计与定向欺骗信号计算，隐蔽精准地将受害无人机重定向至指定位置。本文通过真实场景案例研究验证了该重定向方法与攻击实现的有效性。

title: DESCENT: Directed Edge Scene Encoding for Airport Surface Movement Prediction
title_zh: DESCENT（面向机场场面运动预测的有向边场景编码模型）
authors: Alexander Prutsch, David Schinagl, Horst Possegger
abstract: Advanced automation is a key technology for enhancing the safety of ground operations amidst the increasing density of commercial air traffic. While motion forecasting is a well-studied task in autonomous driving, its application to airport surface movements remains underexplored. To enable efficient and accurate prediction in this domain, we propose DESCENT, a transformer-based architecture designed to handle heterogeneous dynamics and strict topological constraints. Our approach features a Potential Reachable Set (PRS) context sampling mechanism that adaptively collects airfield environment context across diverse operational phases. Combined with a detection transformer-based decoder, DESCENT generates accurate trajectory forecasts. Extensive evaluations on the Amelia-10 benchmark demonstrate significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art baselines. These gains are especially pronounced in safety-critical scenarios, where our domain-aware sampling provides critical long-horizon context necessary for safe navigation.
summary_zh: 在商用航空交通密度不断提升的背景下，先进自动化技术是提升地面运行安全性的核心技术。运动预测是自动驾驶领域已得到充分研究的任务，但在机场场面运动场景下的应用仍有待探索。为实现该领域下高效精准的预测，本文提出DESCENT，一种基于Transformer的架构，专门用于处理异构动力学特征与严格拓扑约束。该方法引入潜在可达集（PRS）上下文采样机制，可跨不同运行阶段自适应采集机场环境上下文信息，结合基于检测Transformer的解码器，DESCENT可生成精准的轨迹预测结果。在Amelia-10基准上的大量评估结果表明，该方法性能相比现有最优基线有显著提升，在安全关键场景下优势尤为明显，本文提出的领域感知采样方法可提供安全导航所需的关键长周期上下文信息。

title: A Statistical Audit of Physical AI Benchmark Redundancy
title_zh: 物理AI基准冗余度统计审计
authors: Zaruhi Navasardyan, Hrant Davtyan
abstract: Physical AI models are evaluated on suites of benchmarks that differ across model reports, leaving the model-by-benchmark matrix sparse and the relationship between benchmarks unmeasured. We construct a matrix of 51 models on 12 physical AI benchmarks, selected from a registry of 51 benchmarks and 152 models by reporting density, combining scores from model cards and benchmark papers with our own evaluation runs under each benchmark's official protocol. We measure how much information the benchmarks share and show quantitative evidence of Redundancy. Redundancy affects reported rankings: collapsing the two substitute pairs into single columns moves 22 of 51 models by three or more places under an equally weighted average. We then select benchmarks greedily under a utility combining score dispersion with variance not explained by the already-selected set, and obtain a four-benchmark subset retaining 78.5\% of the utility of all 12, on which we fit a Bradley--Terry ranking. The procedure requires only benchmark-level scores with sufficient overlap and is not specific to physical AI.
summary_zh: 物理AI模型在不同的基准套件上完成评估，不同模型报告采用的基准存在差异，导致模型-基准矩阵十分稀疏，基准之间的关联关系也未得到量化。本文从包含51个基准、152个模型的注册表中，根据报告密度筛选出12个物理AI基准与51个模型，构建完整矩阵，结合模型卡片、基准论文中的得分与本文按照各基准官方协议完成的评估运行结果，测量不同基准之间的信息共享程度，给出基准存在冗余的定量证据。冗余会影响报告的模型排名：将两组可替代基准合并为单列后，在等权重平均规则下，51个模型中有22个的排名变动超过3位。随后本文在结合得分离散度与未被已选集合解释的方差的效用函数下，贪心筛选基准，得到仅包含4个基准的子集，即可保留全部12个基准78.5%的效用，基于该子集拟合Bradley-Terry排名模型。该流程仅需要存在足够重叠的基准级得分，并非物理AI领域专属方法。

title: Choose Your Game Wisely: Measuring Game-Theoretic Structures in Real-World Vehicle Interactions
title_zh: 审慎选择博弈框架：实测车辆交互中的博弈论结构度量
authors: Yueyuan Li, Rongcheng Nie, Weijie Xi, Mingyang Jiang, Songan Zhang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Game-theoretic models provide principled frameworks for modeling vehicle interactions, but their underlying temporal assumptions have not been systematically examined against real-world driving behavior. In particular, it remains unclear how simultaneous, sequential, and asymmetric interaction structures can be measured from vehicle trajectories. This paper develops a trajectory-based interaction measurement framework to identify interaction events and quantify behavioral change onset, temporal organization, post-onset response dynamics, and ordering stability. The framework uses behavioral deviations to verify candidate interactions. We evaluate the framework on six real-world trajectory datasets, including INTERACTION, highD, inD, rounD, Waymo Open Motion, and nuPlan, covering diverse road geometries, traffic environments, and interaction types. The results show that concurrent and sequential behavioral changes both constitute substantial proportions of observed following, merging, and conflicting interactions. Among sequential interactions, stable ordering is more prevalent than alternating ordering, indicating that persistent asymmetric roles are a common interaction structure. Importantly, temporal precedence does not necessarily coincide with a measurable behavioral response, indicating that temporal ordering alone may not be sufficient to characterize behavioral dependence. These findings show that real-world interactions exhibit concurrent, sequential, and persistently ordered temporal structures. Different game-theoretic formulations are therefore better regarded as complementary modeling abstractions for different interaction regimes rather than as a universal structure governing all vehicle interactions.
summary_zh: 博弈论模型为车辆交互建模提供了严谨的框架，但这类模型的底层时序假设尚未在真实驾驶行为中得到系统性校验。尤其是目前尚不清楚如何从车辆轨迹中测量同步、序贯与非对称交互结构。本文提出基于轨迹的交互度量框架，可识别交互事件，量化行为变化起始点、时序组织、起始后响应动力学与排序稳定性。该框架通过行为偏差验证候选交互的有效性。本文在6个真实世界轨迹数据集上对框架进行评估，包括INTERACTION、highD、inD、rounD、Waymo Open Motion与nuPlan，覆盖多样化的道路几何、交通环境与交互类型。结果表明，同步与序贯行为变化在观测到的跟车、汇入与冲突交互中均占据相当大的比例。在序贯交互中，稳定排序的占比高于交替排序，说明持续非对称角色是常见的交互结构。重要的是，时序领先并不一定对应可测量的行为响应，说明仅靠时序排序不足以表征行为依赖关系。上述发现表明真实世界交互同时存在同步、序贯与持续有序的时序结构，因此不同的博弈论范式应被视为适用于不同交互场景的互补建模抽象，而非适用于所有车辆交互的通用结构。

title: Low-Resolution Perception for Robotic Packing
title_zh: 面向机器人装箱任务的低分辨率感知方法
authors: Giuseppe Fabio Preziosa, Federico Vignoni, Chiara Castellano, Marco Faroni, Andrea Maria Zanchettin 等 (6 人)
abstract: This work tackles the problem of scalable perception for robotic packing with low-cost, low-resolution depth sensing. We propose a framework where reconstruction cues drive next-view selection and grasp evidence updates a per-object stability estimate, jointly deciding what to acquire next and when to grasp. During the reconstruction, a low-resolution Next Best View (NBV) strategy explicitly avoids redundant views while preserving task-relevant geometry. We validate the approach in two steps: (i) an ablation study of the utility function under very low resolution, and (ii) a full end-to-end evaluation across policies, showing how low-resolution perception is a practical, scalable option for robotic packing.
summary_zh: 本文针对采用低成本低分辨率深度传感的机器人装箱任务，研究可规模化的感知方案。本文提出一种框架，由重建线索驱动下一视角选择，抓取证据更新单物体稳定性估计，共同决定下一步需要采集的信息与抓取时机。在重建过程中，低分辨率下一最优视角（NBV）策略可在保留任务相关几何特征的前提下，显式规避冗余视角。本文通过两步验证该方法的有效性：（1）极低分辨率场景下效用函数的消融实验；（2）跨不同策略的完整端到端评估，证明低分辨率感知是适用于机器人装箱的实用、可规模化方案。

title: VISTA: Visually Inferred Spatial ConTact Attention for Contact-Rich Manipulation
title_zh: VISTA（视觉推断空间接触注意力模型）：面向富接触操作的视觉推断空间接触注意力机制
authors: Jiayi Chen, Wenlong Dong, Yan Huang, Xianglin Chen, Zijian Lin 等 (8 人)
abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise interaction feedback. While vision-centric imitation learning is prevalent, external visual observations provide indirect and ambiguous cues about contact states, particularly under occlusion or subtle object--gripper interactions; dedicated tactile or force sensors can provide rich contact information but introduce additional hardware complexity, calibration requirements, and deployment costs. To bridge this gap, we propose VISTA-Policy, an imitation learning paradigm that utilizes the Visual Deformation Field (VDF), a 3D displacement representation of a compliant gripper, as high-dimensional visuo-physical feedback. The framework integrates: 1) a Physics-Aware Encoding Engine for real-time VDF decoding; 2) an Energy Aggregation Denoising Mechanism to isolate true interaction signals; and 3) a Deformation-Augmented Policy Network with incremental gripper actions for precise closed-loop correction. Extensive evaluations on Cross-Scale Object Grasping, Cap Unscrewing, and Calligraphy Writing demonstrate that VISTA-Policy outperforms the strong pure-vision baseline 3D Diffusion Policy and the tactile baseline. VISTA-Policy further demonstrates substantial out-of-distribution generalization to unseen object scales and robustness against dynamic disturbances, offering a durable and cost-effective route toward general-purpose fine-grained manipulation in unstructured environments. Project videos and supplementary materials are available at:this https URL.
summary_zh: 富接触操作需要精准的交互反馈。尽管以视觉为核心的模仿学习已得到广泛应用，但外部视觉观测仅能提供关于接触状态的间接模糊线索，在存在遮挡或物体-夹爪交互十分细微的场景下尤为明显；专用的触觉或力传感器可提供丰富的接触信息，但会引入额外的硬件复杂度、标定需求与部署成本。为解决该问题，本文提出VISTA-Policy，一种模仿学习范式，将视觉形变场（VDF，即柔顺夹爪的3D位移表征）作为高维视觉-物理反馈。该框架集成三个模块：1）用于实时VDF解码的物理感知编码引擎；2）用于分离真实交互信号的能量聚合去噪机制；3）搭载增量夹爪动作的形变增强策略网络，用于实现精准闭环校正。在跨尺度物体抓取、瓶盖拧开与书法书写任务上的大量评估表明，VISTA-Policy的表现优于当前最优的纯视觉基线3D Diffusion Policy与触觉基线。VISTA-Policy在未见物体尺度上展现出极强的分布外泛化能力，同时对动态扰动具备鲁棒性，为非结构化环境下的通用细粒度操作提供了一条高性价比的可行路径。项目视频与补充材料可访问对应链接获取。

title: MA-VLA: Multi-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Collaboration and Compositional Generalization
title_zh: MA-VLA（多臂视觉-语言-动作模型）：面向协作与组合泛化的多臂视觉语言动作模型
authors: Zaibin Zhang, Junlan Xiao, Zhongbo Zhang, Yifan Wang, Li Kang 等 (14 人)
abstract: Multi-arm collaboration is becoming a core capability in embodied manipulation. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate perception, language, and control, but most represent language as a single global instruction and do not provide an explicit mechanism for assigning and composing arm-specific behaviors. This design limits transfer to collaboration patterns that differ from those observed during training. We present MA-VLA, a unified framework for multi-arm collaboration via atomic action assignment. MA-VLA decomposes cooperative behavior into mid-level atomic prompts and allocates them to individual arms, enabling explicit subgoal specification and compositional reuse across tasks. To reduce reliance on fixed execution roles, we introduce Arm Shuffle, a training-time permutation of the observation, state, and assigned atomic prompts for each arm. This permutation enforces role-agnostic instruction following and supports recomposition into unseen coordination patterns, which we term multi-arm compositional generalization. We also construct a benchmark in which test-time collaboration patterns are absent in training set. Across simulation and real-world evaluations, prior state-of-the-art VLAs largely fail under these unseen collaborations, while MA-VLA consistently succeeds. These results indicate that structured, per-arm atomic action assignment offers a practical route to scalable generalization in multi-arm embodied systems. Code, models, and data are available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 多臂协作正在成为具身操作的核心能力。近期提出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型集成了感知、语言与控制能力，但大多将语言表征为单一全局指令，未提供分配与组合单臂专属行为的显式机制。该设计限制了模型向训练阶段未见过的协作模式的迁移能力。本文提出MA-VLA，一种通过原子动作分配实现多臂协作的统一框架。MA-VLA将协作行为分解为中层原子提示，分配给单个机械臂，实现显式子目标指定与跨任务的组合复用。为降低对固定执行角色的依赖，本文引入Arm Shuffle训练机制，在训练阶段对每个机械臂的观测、状态与分配的原子提示进行置换。该置换机制强制模型遵循角色无关的指令，支持重组为训练阶段未见过的协调模式，本文将其定义为多臂组合泛化。本文还构建了一个基准测试集，其中测试阶段的协作模式完全不存在于训练集中。在仿真与真实场景评估中，现有最优VLA模型在这类未见协作场景下大多失败，而MA-VLA可稳定完成任务。上述结果表明，结构化的单臂原子动作分配是实现多臂具身系统可规模化泛化的可行路径。代码、模型与数据可访问对应链接获取。

title: Anytime Global Tensor Motion Planning
title_zh: 任意时刻全局张量运动规划
authors: Sai Coumar, An T. Le, Zachary Kingston
abstract: Global Tensor Motion Planning (GTMP) solves motion planning with batched tensor operations over a layered multipartite graph. We generalize GTMP so that adjacent-layer edges are realized by any black-box local planner (e.g., linear interpolation, splines, sampling-based planning, trajectory optimization, or generative sampling). We provide two anytime policies on top of this generalization: Anytime GTMP with random restarts at a fixed budget, which covers every homotopy class almost surely, and AO-GTMP with informed expansion with growing budgets, which converges to the optimal cost. We prove that a single sampled graph covers every endpoint-fixed homotopy class admitting a \(\delta\)-clear representative of bounded length. We also prove that additional samples per layer reduce the per-layer miss probability exponentially, whereas stronger local planners reduce the required layer count only sublinearly. On manipulation benchmarks the method matches state-of-the-art performance, and on 2D navigation it returns batches of topologically diverse solutions, while the informed baselines concentrate on one or two classes.
summary_zh: 全局张量运动规划（Global Tensor Motion Planning, GTMP）通过在分层多部分图上执行批量张量运算求解运动规划问题。本文对GTMP进行泛化，使相邻层边可通过任意黑盒局部规划器实现，例如线性插值、样条曲线、基于采样的规划、轨迹优化或生成式采样。在该泛化基础上提出两种任意时刻策略：第一种是固定预算下带随机重启的任意时刻GTMP，几乎可覆盖所有同伦类；第二种是预算动态增长、采用启发式扩展的AO-GTMP，可收敛到最优代价。本文证明，单个采样图可覆盖所有满足δ-清晰代表且长度有界的端点固定同伦类；同时证明，每层新增采样点可使每层漏检概率呈指数级下降，而性能更强的局部规划器仅能使所需层数呈次线性下降。在操作任务基准测试中，该方法性能达到当前最优水平；在2D导航任务中可输出一批拓扑多样性的解，而对比的启发式基线方法仅能集中生成1到2类解。

title: AGRO-Nav: Autonomous Graph-based Orchard Navigation
title_zh: AGRO-Nav：基于图的自主果园导航
authors: Ho Young Yun, Jaemin Yu, Duksu Kim
abstract: Orchards form semi-structured environments in which parallel tree rows create natural driving corridors, yet narrow inter-row clearance and dense foliage lead geometry-agnostic grid planners to drift off the row center and risk trunk or canopy contact. We present AGRO-Nav, an automated framework for static graph-based global planning in orchards. From tree-row lines fitted to trunk clusters in a SLAM point cloud, it builds, without any manual waypoints, a sparse topological graph of intra- and inter-row connectivity; a global route is then found by Dijkstra search on this graph, connected to the start and goal by any-angle Theta* segments, and smoothed with a cubic B-spline. In real-orchard trials, AGRO-Nav follows the row center with a mean error of about 0.08 m, far below the A* (0.31 m) and Theta* (0.43 m) shortest-path baselines, while planning roughly four to five times faster. In Isaac Sim, it attains the lowest error among A*, Theta*, and a reproduced RANSAC midline baseline and remains stable as tree density drops to 70%, where the RANSAC baseline degrades. The resulting trajectories---straight row-centered segments joined by controlled turns---suit differential-drive and four-wheel-steering platforms.
summary_zh: 果园属于半结构化环境，平行树行形成天然行驶通道，但狭窄的行间间隙和茂密枝叶会导致不考虑几何特征的栅格规划器偏离行中心，存在碰撞树干或树冠的风险。本文提出AGRO-Nav，一种面向果园场景、基于静态图全局规划的自动化框架。该框架从同步定位与建图（SLAM）点云的树干聚类中拟合树行线，无需人工设置航点即可构建描述行内与行间连通性的稀疏拓扑图；随后在该图上通过Dijkstra搜索得到全局路径，路径的起点和终点段通过任意角度Theta*算法生成，并采用三次B样条平滑。在真实果园试验中，AGRO-Nav沿行中心行驶的平均误差约为0.08m，远低于A*（0.31m）和Theta*（0.43m）最短路径基线，同时规划速度快4至5倍。在Isaac Sim仿真环境中，该方法的误差在A*、Theta*和复现的RANSAC中线基线中最低，且在树木密度降至70%时仍保持稳定，而RANSAC基线性能会出现退化。最终生成的轨迹由沿行中心的直线路段和受控转弯段组成，适配差速驱动和四轮转向平台。

title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
title_zh: TacForcing：融合执行阶段触觉反馈的流式动作生成
authors: Jianbo Zhou, Boyuan Zhao, Yuzheng Zhang, Yiyang Chen, Wenxin Chen 等 (11 人)
abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework that effectively incorporates execution-time tactile feedback. Instead of employing a separate reactive controller, TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming action expert to generate actions conditioned on the evolving tactile observations acquired during execution. TacForcing also introduces Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts tactile conditioning to actions nearing execution, thereby reducing the temporal mismatch between tactile acquisition and action execution. Across six simulated UniVTAC tasks and three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, TacForcing achieves average success rates of 65% and 69%, respectively, outperforming strong baselines in both settings.
summary_zh: 高接触操作任务需要适配在动作执行周期内可能发生显著变化的接触状态。然而，基于分块的视觉-语言-动作模型仅根据执行前采集的观测数据预测完整动作块，导致执行过程中的触觉条件信息过时。现有触觉反应类方法通常依赖独立的高频控制器，会同时提升架构复杂度和训练复杂度。本文提出TacForcing，一种可有效融合执行阶段触觉反馈的流式动作生成框架。TacForcing不使用独立的反应控制器，而是将标准动作专家替换为流式动作专家，根据执行过程中获取的动态触觉观测生成条件动作。TacForcing还提出了执行感知触觉注意力机制（Execution-Aware Tactile Attention, EATA），将触觉条件限制在即将执行的动作上，从而降低触觉采集与动作执行之间的时间失配问题。在6个仿真UniVTAC任务和3个真实世界高接触操作任务中，TacForcing的平均成功率分别达到65%和69%，在两类场景中均优于性能优异的基线方法。

title: LM-X: Explainable Action Modeling with Progress, Event, and Uncertainty Prediction for Generalist Robot Manipulation
title_zh: LM-X：面向通用机器人操作的融合进度、事件与不确定性预测的可解释动作建模
authors: Jin Lou, Jingxuan Zhu, Andong Chen, Xupeng Wang, Yuan Xu 等 (17 人)
abstract: Generalist vision--language--action (VLA) policies learn long-horizon behavior mainly through short-horizon action prediction and reveal little beyond sampled commands. This creates two coupled bottlenecks: a single action target must implicitly absorb task progress, intermediate intent, and local reliability, while these control states remain hidden during execution. Inspired by functional principles of biological sensorimotor control, we introduce LM-X , which organizes prediction across task, event, and motor scales without claiming anatomical correspondence. Three explicitly supervised signals are emitted online and directly condition action generation: return-to-go (RTG) measures visible task progress, event-to-go (ETG) identifies the next semantic transition, and heteroscedastic action flow estimates local reliability through propagated variance. Explanation is therefore intrinsic to control rather than generated post hoc. Before a costly 20-day pretraining run on 64 NVIDIA B200 GPUs, a controlled five-task pretraining gate verifies the design: the complete model improves success by 16.0 points over the action-only backbone and by 10.8 points over the strongest single-head variant. We then train LM-X on more than 20,000 hours of real-robot trajectories, including over 1,000 hours of failed policy rollouts. LM-X achieves 74.1\% across 50 randomized-hard RoboTwin2.0 tasks versus 55.4\% for GR00T N1.7, and 68.6\% versus 50.7\% across seven real-robot tasks. RTG tracks semantic progress and visible regression, while variance rises during hesitation and oscillatory control. These results show that explicit multi-timescale predictive state can strengthen control while exposing interpretable internal estimates.
summary_zh: 通用视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）策略主要通过短周期动作预测学习长周期行为，除输出采样指令外几乎不提供其他可解释信息，由此产生两个耦合瓶颈：单个动作目标必须隐式承载任务进度、中间意图和局部可靠性信息，而这些控制状态在执行过程中完全不可见。受生物感觉运动控制功能原理的启发，本文提出LM-X框架，该框架在不对应解剖结构的前提下，在任务、事件和运动三个尺度上组织预测过程。框架在线输出三个显式监督信号，直接作为动作生成的条件：剩余回报（Return-to-Go, RTG）衡量可见任务进度，剩余事件（Event-to-Go, ETG）识别下一个语义转换，异方差动作流通过传播方差估计局部可靠性。因此可解释性是控制过程的固有属性，而非事后生成的附加结果。在64张NVIDIA B200 GPU上开展耗时20天的高成本预训练之前，通过受控5任务预训练门验证了设计有效性：完整模型的成功率比仅执行动作预测的主干网络高16.0个百分点，比性能最强的单头变体高10.8个百分点。随后在超过20000小时的真实机器人轨迹（包含1000小时以上的策略失败 rollout 数据）上训练LM-X，在50个随机难度RoboTwin2.0任务上的成功率达74.1%，对比GR00T N1.7的55.4%；在7个真实机器人任务上的成功率达68.6%，对比GR00T N1.7的50.7%。RTG可跟踪语义进度和可见回归，而方差会在机器人犹豫和振荡控制阶段上升。上述结果表明，显式多时间尺度预测状态可在提升控制性能的同时输出可解释的内部估计值。

title: Trust-Aware Sequential Decision Making and Rollout Planning for Resilient Multi-Robot Systems
title_zh: 面向弹性多机器人系统的信任感知序贯决策与rollout规划
authors: Roee M. Francos, Daniel Garces, Orhan Eren Akgün, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Stephanie Gil
abstract: Sequential decision-making in multi-robot systems typically assumes that planning information is reliable and that agents execute the actions anticipated by the planner. Compromised agents can violate both assumptions, creating a mismatch between the planning model and physical execution. We study this problem in online multi-robot routing under localization spoofing. We introduce a distance-constrained spoofing model for monitor-aware adversaries, together with a tiered bipartite matching strategy that maximizes assignment influence while limiting spoofing magnitude. To mitigate such attacks, we develop a trust-aware monitor that combines probabilistic localization trust, calibrated using real GPS spoofing data, with behavioral evidence from task execution to classify agents and remove detected adversaries from subsequent planning. We further show that undetected adversaries can cause rollout to lose its expected cost-improvement behavior by violating planner-execution consistency. Trust-aware removal restores this consistency after detection, enabling stable routing and recovery of rollout's empirical advantage over the base policy. Experiments using real GPS spoofing datasets and San Francisco taxicab demand demonstrate effective detection and resilient routing across varying spoofing capabilities, adversarial fleet sizes, adaptive attacks, monitoring configurations, and rollout horizons.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统的序贯决策通常假设规划信息可靠，且智能体执行的动作与规划器预期一致。被入侵的智能体可同时违反这两个假设，导致规划模型与实际执行过程失配。本文在存在定位欺骗的在线多机器人路由场景下研究该问题，提出面向感知监控的攻击者的距离约束欺骗模型，以及可在限制欺骗幅度的同时最大化分配影响的分层二分匹配策略。为缓解这类攻击，本文开发了信任感知监控器，融合经真实GPS欺骗数据校准的概率定位信任值与任务执行过程中的行为证据，对智能体进行分类，将检测到的攻击者排除在后续规划流程之外。本文进一步证明，未被检测到的攻击者会破坏规划器-执行一致性，导致rollout方法失去预期的代价优化特性。在检测到攻击者后执行信任感知移除操作可恢复该一致性，实现稳定路由，还原rollout方法相对基础策略的经验优势。基于真实GPS欺骗数据集和旧金山出租车需求数据的实验表明，该方法在不同欺骗能力、敌对机群规模、自适应攻击、监控配置和rollout周期下均能实现有效检测和弹性路由。

title: Opportunities of Self Supervised Learning for GNSS: Evaluation of a Deep Learning-Enhanced PVT Algorithm
authors: Thomas Barbero, Bertrand Ekambi
abstract: This work proposes a Deep Learning Enhanced PVT algorithm to mitigate multipath interference in dense urban areas. A supervised objective jointly predicts range corrections and uncertainty, while a JEPA-based self-supervised pretraining stage improves representation quality. The algorithm is evaluated over diverse driving scenarios, substantially improving PVT accuracy, particularly for unseen harsh urban conditions. These results highlight the potential of unlabelled GNSS data to improve generalization performance.

title: PRISM: Projection-Integrated Sampling-Based MPC with Bayesian Cost Tuning for Bimanual Manipulation
title_zh: PRISM：面向双臂操作的融合贝叶斯代价调优的投影集成采样型模型预测控制
authors: Alinjar Dan, Iryna Hurova, Karl Kruusamäe, Arun Kumar Singh
abstract: Bimanual manipulation in cluttered, contact-rich environments remains challenging because it requires coordinated motion generation, interaction-aware planning, and reliable execution under tight kinematic constraints. We present PRISM, a projection-integrated sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that uses a GPU-accelerated physics simulator as an online world model for complex dual-arm manipulation.The main algorithmic contribution is a QP-guided control sampling strategy that decouples trajectory exploration from kinematic feasibility. At each MPC step, sampled joint-velocity trajectories are projected onto the set of motions satisfying joint position, velocity, acceleration, and jerk bounds, together with an initial-velocity boundary condition, before rollout evaluation. This enables broad yet feasible exploration of coordinated bimanual behaviors. To support efficient online execution, we derive a custom ADMM/Bregman-splitting QP solver that exploits joint-wise separability and reusable matrix factorizations. We further use Bayesian optimization to tune task-cost weights offline, reducing manual parameter selection.We evaluate PRISM on challenging variants of PerAct$^{2}$ tasks, including obstacle-constrained ball transport, tray transport, cube handover, and box lifting. Experiments show improved robustness and task success relative to representative sampling-based baselines, while maintaining real-time or near-real-time execution. We also demonstrate successful sim-to-real transfer on dual UR5e manipulators, highlighting the practical potential of physics-based online planning for contact-rich bimanual manipulation. Project details, including code and supplementary videos, are available at \href{this https URL}{\texttt{this https URL}}.
summary_zh: 在杂乱、高接触环境下的双臂操作任务仍存在较大挑战，需要生成协同运动、具备交互感知规划能力，且在严格运动学约束下实现可靠执行。本文提出PRISM，一种融合投影的采样型模型预测控制（Model Predictive Control, MPC）框架，采用GPU加速的物理仿真器作为在线世界模型，处理复杂双臂操作任务。该算法的核心贡献是二次规划（QP）引导的控制采样策略，将轨迹探索与运动可行性解耦。在每个MPC步中，采样得到的关节速度轨迹会先投影到满足关节位置、速度、加速度、加加速度边界以及初始速度边界条件的运动集合中，再执行rollout评估，从而在可行域内大范围探索协同双臂行为。为支持高效在线执行，本文推导了自定义的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）/Bregman分裂QP求解器，利用关节级可分性和可复用矩阵分解提升效率。本文进一步采用贝叶斯优化离线调整任务代价权重，减少人工参数选择工作量。在PerAct²任务的高难度变体（包括带障碍物约束的球体运输、托盘运输、物体交接和箱体抬升）上对PRISM进行评估，实验结果表明，对比代表性采样基线方法，该方法的鲁棒性和任务成功率更高，同时可保持实时或近实时执行性能。本文还在双UR5e机械臂上完成了仿真到真实场景的迁移验证，证明了基于物理的在线规划方法在高接触双臂操作场景中的实用价值。项目详情（含代码和补充视频）可访问对应公开链接获取。

title: GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: GaussianDream++：面向机器人操作的高效3D高斯世界建模
authors: Yuqing Jiang, Zijian Zhang, Weitao Zhou, Jiawei Wang, Junjie He 等 (11 人)
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet action-imitation objectives provide only weak supervision for metric 3D structure and short-horizon physical evolution. Geometry-enhanced policies mainly improve current-scene grounding, whereas predictive policies often model future dynamics in RGB or latent spaces and may incur substantial deployment cost. GaussianDream demonstrates that training-time current Gaussian reconstruction and future Gaussian prediction provide effective 3D supervision, but its dense VGGT/TGE-based prefix jointly carries state, dynamics, and action-conditioning information. We present \textbf{\methodname}, a compact, policy-native extension that inserts \textbf{World State Tokens} and \textbf{World Prediction Tokens} directly into the VLA backbone. A training-only \textbf{World Representation Head} decodes these tokens into a Current World and coupled Future Prediction over shared Gaussian primitives, while static--dynamic factorization preserves persistent structure and focuses residual motion on interaction-relevant regions. At inference, the head, renderer, auxiliary objectives, and VGGT/TGE pathway are removed, leaving only 20 world tokens without online Gaussian decoding or rollout. \method achieves \textbf{98.6\%} on LIBERO and \textbf{87.8\%} on LIBERO-Plus, with clear gains under Camera and Layout shifts. Real-robot experiments further improve average success from 29.2\% to 52.5\% over reproduced $\pi_{0.5}$ while maintaining efficient closed-loop control.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略推动了语言条件机器人操作技术的发展，但动作模仿目标仅能为度量3D结构和短周期物理演化提供弱监督。几何增强型策略主要提升当前场景的 grounding 能力，而预测型策略通常在RGB空间或隐空间中建模未来动力学，部署成本较高。GaussianDream方法证明，在训练阶段执行当前高斯重建和未来高斯预测可为3D任务提供有效监督，但其基于密集VGGT/TGE的前缀同时承载状态、动力学和动作条件信息。本文提出GaussianDream++，一种面向策略原生的紧凑扩展架构，直接在VLA主干网络中插入世界状态令牌和世界预测令牌。仅在训练阶段使用的世界表征头将这些令牌解码为共享高斯基元上的当前世界和耦合未来预测，同时通过静态-动态因子分解保留持久结构，将残差运动聚焦到交互相关区域。在推理阶段，可移除该表征头、渲染器、辅助目标和VGGT/TGE路径，仅保留20个世界令牌，无需在线高斯解码或rollout。GaussianDream++在LIBERO数据集上的成功率达98.6%，在LIBERO-Plus数据集上达87.8%，在相机参数和场景布局偏移场景下性能提升显著。真实机器人实验表明，对比复现的π₀.₅策略，该方法的平均成功率从29.2%提升至52.5%，同时可保持高效的闭环控制。

title: EgoNav: Bridging Learned Waypoints and Geometry-Aware Local Control for Robust Indoor Navigation
title_zh: EgoNav：融合学习航点与几何感知局部控制的鲁棒室内导航
authors: Jing Wang, Shiqi Zhao, Hairong Qu, Peng Yin
abstract: Image-goal navigation using lightweight topological maps is a practical paradigm for indoor robot deployment: the map requires only geotagged images, and localization relies on visual matching rather than precise pose estimation. However, learned waypoint predictors can produce targets that violate geometric constraints or deviate from the global path. Executing these waypoints safely further requires a local planner capable of collision avoidance, yet existing systems either lack one or rely on fixed parameters that cannot adapt to confined spaces. To address these limitations while retaining the navigational intuition of the learned predictor, we present EgoNav, a hierarchical system that implements this idea by generating candidates from semantically segmented traversable regions and scoring them alongside the learned waypoint for geometric safety, directional coherence, and fidelity to the learned prior. An adaptive local path planner then executes the refined waypoint with parameters modulated based on the refinement outcome. Experiments in Habitat-sim and on a physical humanoid robot show that EgoNav consistently outperforms contemporary baselines in both success rate and path efficiency.
summary_zh: 基于轻量拓扑地图的图像目标导航是室内机器人部署的实用范式：该类地图仅需带地理标签的图像，定位依赖视觉匹配而非精确位姿估计。然而，学习得到的航点预测器可能生成违反几何约束或偏离全局路径的目标点。要安全执行这些航点还需要具备避障能力的局部规划器，但现有系统要么缺少对应模块，要么依赖无法适配狭窄空间的固定参数。为解决上述局限性，同时保留学习预测器的导航直觉，本文提出EgoNav分层系统：该系统从语义分割得到的可通行区域中生成候选点，结合学习得到的航点对候选点进行评分，评估维度包括几何安全性、方向一致性和与学习先验的保真度。随后自适应局部路径规划器根据评分结果调整参数，执行优化后的航点。在Habitat-sim仿真环境和真人形机器人平台上的实验表明，EgoNav在成功率和路径效率上始终优于当前主流基线方法。

title: Leveraging Inter-object Affordances for Efficient Planning in Contact-rich Tasks
title_zh: 利用物体间可供性实现高接触任务的高效规划
authors: Pouya P. Niaz, Justus Piater, Alejandro Agostini
abstract: Traditional task-and-motion planning (TAMP) approaches primarily focus on defining sequences of actions along with the necessary geometric and kinematic constraints to execute long-horizon tasks. However, their applicability in real-world settings is limited, as they typically assume simplified object models that overlook key physical properties critical for the successful execution of contact-rich tasks. Moreover, they often use sub-symbolic reasoning during motion planning, which drastically increases planning time and decreases overall success rates. We propose a method that leverages a TAMP approach, defining object-centric abstractions of execution constraints, called Unified TAMP (U-TAMP), to execute robotic tasks involving interactions among objects with heterogeneous shapes, sizes, and materials. Using a Vision-Language Model (VLM), we generate abstractions of inter-object affordances for characterizing physical interaction constraints between objects in contact-rich tasks, such as grasp and support constraints. These constraints are used to enrich the U-TAMP planning domain to deal with objects with variable physical properties. We perform experiments in simulated kitchen table organization scenarios and compare our results with those of the original U-TAMP, as well as a state-of-the-art VLM-based planner that leverages common sense knowledge of objects' affordances for plan generation. Our approach achieves significantly higher planning success rates and improves planning times by one to two orders of magnitude compared to other methods.
summary_zh: 传统任务与运动规划（Task-and-Motion Planning, TAMP）方法主要聚焦于定义动作序列以及执行长周期任务所需的几何和运动学约束。但这类方法在真实场景中的应用受限，因为它们通常采用简化物体模型，忽略了对高接触任务成功执行至关重要的关键物理属性；此外这类方法在运动规划阶段常使用子符号推理，大幅提升规划时间，降低整体成功率。本文提出一种基于TAMP的方法，定义以物体为中心的执行约束抽象，称为统一TAMP（Unified TAMP, U-TAMP），用于执行涉及不同形状、尺寸、材质物体交互的机器人任务。该方法利用视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）生成物体间可供性抽象，用于表征高接触任务（如抓取和支撑约束）中接触物体之间的物理交互约束。这些约束被用于扩展U-TAMP规划域，以处理物理属性可变的物体。在仿真厨房整理场景下开展实验，将本文方法与原始U-TAMP、以及当前最优的基于VLM的规划器（利用物体可供性常识生成规划）进行对比，结果表明本文方法的规划成功率显著更高，规划速度比其他方法快1到2个数量级。

title: Advantage-Driven Explicit Memory for Social Navigation
title_zh: 面向社交导航的优势驱动型显式记忆机制
authors: Yeonsoo Park, Mattia Racca, Guillaume Bono, Steeven Janny, Gianluca Monaci 等 (7 人)
abstract: Robot policies are predominantly learned with classical parametric variants of imitation learning or RL, where training stores the agent's behavior exclusively in the policy's network parameters, putting a heavy burden on the representation learning algorithm. We propose a new navigation agent equipped with non-parametric memory which explicitly indexes prior steps leading to critical events. The advantages are twofold: first, it allows the policy to outsource some of its behavior into an explicit memory; second, it encourages a form of continual learning by allowing an agent to collect data from its testing episodes during deployment and therefore to better generalize to OOD situations. In the context of social navigation, we show that this improves the agent's capability to retain sparse, high-cost failures, such as human collisions. If the policy is trained in simulation, this also naturally addresses the sim-to-real gap, partially, by basing some of the decision making on real data. We integrate the explicit memory into a recurrent PPO architecture and use hidden states for memory retrieval to capture continuous spatiotemporal dynamics. The goal of exploiting rare, high-impact events is achieved by leveraging the RL agent's advantage signals. We train our agent in simulation with a combination of photorealistic rendering and non-visual crowd simulation and show that the agent is robust with respect to OOD social behavior.
summary_zh: 机器人策略大多采用经典参数化变体的模仿学习或强化学习方法训练，训练过程中智能体的行为仅存储在策略的网络参数中，给表征学习算法带来极大负担。本文提出一种搭载非参数化记忆模块的新型导航智能体，该模块可显式索引指向关键事件的历史步骤。该设计有两点优势：第一，允许策略将部分行为存储到显式记忆中；第二，通过让智能体在部署阶段从测试片段中收集数据推动持续学习，从而更好地泛化到分布外（OOD）场景。在社交导航场景下，我们证明该机制可提升智能体对稀疏、高代价失败案例（例如与人发生碰撞）的留存能力。若策略在仿真环境中训练，该机制还可通过将部分决策基于真实数据，自然地在一定程度上弥合仿真到现实的差距。我们将显式记忆模块集成到循环近端策略优化（PPO）架构中，利用隐状态实现记忆检索，捕捉连续时空动态特性。通过利用强化学习智能体的优势信号，实现了对罕见、高影响事件的挖掘目标。我们结合照片级真实渲染和非视觉人群仿真技术在仿真环境中训练智能体，实验结果表明该智能体对分布外的社交行为具备鲁棒性。

title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: RA-VLA：面向测试时自适应的检索增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型
authors: Sanghwan Jang, Minjin Jeon, Minsoo Kim, Seongjin Choi, Dongha Kim 等 (6 人)
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a versatile foundation for general robotic manipulation, yet they exhibit significant brittleness when confronted with novel task distributions. While In-Context Imitation Learning (ICIL) offers a training-free alternative, existing frameworks suffer from an adaptation bottleneck that hinders the effective translation of expert context to executable actions. This failure originates from superficial retrieval mechanisms and an inherent behavioral inertia that anchors the policy to its pre-trained priors. To address these limitations, we present RA-VLA, a retrieval-augmented VLA framework that integrates behavior-aligned context retrieval with a grounded execution pipeline. By enforcing faithful adherence to functional cues within a scalable architecture, RA-VLA facilitates seamless task adaptation while preserving inference efficiency. Our empirical evaluations across the LIBERO benchmark and a real-world UR5e environment demonstrate that RA-VLA achieves superior success rates and computational efficiency, establishing a robust framework for training-free robotic adaptation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用机器人操作提供了通用基础框架，但面对全新任务分布时表现出显著的脆弱性。尽管上下文模仿学习（ICIL）提供了无需训练的替代方案，但现有框架存在自适应瓶颈，阻碍专家上下文信息有效转化为可执行动作。该缺陷源于表层检索机制以及固有行为惯性——后者会将策略锚定在预训练先验上。为解决上述局限，本文提出RA-VLA，一种检索增强的VLA框架，将行为对齐的上下文检索与落地执行流水线相结合。通过在可扩展架构中强制忠实遵循功能线索，RA-VLA可在保留推理效率的前提下实现无缝任务自适应。我们在LIBERO基准测试集和真实UR5e机器人环境中开展的大量实证评估表明，RA-VLA取得了更优的成功率与计算效率，为无需训练的机器人自适应提供了鲁棒框架。

title: ConfAL-WM: Confidence-Guided Active Learning for Action-Conditioned World Models
title_zh: ConfAL-WM：面向动作条件世界模型的置信度引导主动学习框架
authors: Xiang Liu, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang
abstract: Action-conditioned world models have become an important foundation for embodied prediction, planning, and synthetic data generation, but their errors under new task and scene distributions are often concentrated in localized spatiotemporal regions such as robot arms, manipulated objects, contact areas, and occluded objects. This paper presents ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models. Built upon EVAC, we attach a lightweight confidence probe to UNet decoder features and predict dense confidence maps in the latent space. These maps are aggregated into task-, frame-, and patch-level scores, enabling both efficient data selection and localized training enhancement. Our pipeline first retrains the confidence probe and warms up EVAC with a small subset of target-domain data, then performs task-level prescreening to allocate sampling budgets, and finally applies selected-data retraining with optional frame or patch weighted data enhancement. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 show that confidence-guided selection improves post-training efficiency, while dense frame and patch weighting further enhances prediction quality and embodied trajectory consistency compared with scalar reward, progress, and judge-based scoring baselines. A quick visual overview of this work is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 动作条件世界模型已成为具身预测、规划与合成数据生成的重要基础，但在新任务与场景分布下，其误差往往集中在局部时空区域，例如机械臂、操作对象、接触区域与被遮挡物体。本文提出ConfAL-WM，一种用于具身世界模型后训练的置信度引导主动学习框架。该框架基于EVAC模型构建，在UNet解码器特征上附加轻量级置信度探针，在隐空间中预测密集置信度图。这些置信度图可聚合为任务级、帧级与块级得分，同时实现高效数据选择与局部训练增强。我们的流水线首先使用小批量目标域数据重新训练置信度探针并预热EVAC模型，随后执行任务级预筛选以分配采样预算，最后使用选定数据进行重训练，可选择搭配帧或块加权数据增强。在RoboTwin2.0平台上开展的实验表明，与基于标量奖励、进度和判别得分的基线方法相比，置信度引导的选择机制提升了后训练效率，而密集帧与块加权进一步提升了预测质量与具身轨迹一致性。可通过对应链接查看本工作的快速可视化概览。

title: A Tendon-Driven Five-Fingered Hand with Distributed Tactile Perception for Dexterous Manipulation
title_zh: 面向灵巧操作的带分布式触觉感知的腱驱动五指机械手
authors: Huayang Chen, Longhui Qin
abstract: To apply the techniques of embodied artificial intelligence to human-oid robots for complex manipulations, dexterous robotic hands are indispensable, which are restricted by the dexterity and tactile perception capability. In this work, we proposed a novel design of tendon-driven five-fingered hand with dis-tributed tactile perception. With a soft-rigid-hybrid structure employed, both compliance and operational force are endowed to the hand. Dual-modality tactile sensing elements are distributed on the distal and middle phalanges of all five fingers, enabling the simultaneous detection of static contact and dynamic force variations. Manipulation experiments, including counting gestures, finger-to-thumb pinching, object grasping, and bottle-grasp tactile recording, demonstrate the feasibility of the integrated actuation-perception system.
summary_zh: 为将具身人工智能技术应用于人形机器人以完成复杂操作任务，具备高灵巧性与触觉感知能力的灵巧机械手是不可或缺的核心部件。本文提出一种新型带分布式触觉感知的腱驱动五指机械手设计。该机械手采用刚软混合结构，同时兼具柔顺性与操作力输出能力。双模态触觉传感单元分布在五根手指的远节与中节指骨上，可同时检测静态接触与动态力变化。计数手势、指捏动作、物体抓取与持瓶触觉记录等操作实验验证了该集成驱动-感知系统的可行性。

title: Dynamic Modeling of a Welding Torch Umbilical and Its Impact on Robot Dynamics
title_zh: 焊枪缆管动力学建模及其对机器人动力学的影响研究
authors: Nicolas Gautier, Yves Guillermit, Mathieu Porez, Fabien Rousset, Damien Chablat
abstract: Robotic welding is widely used in industrial manufacturing, where the welding torch is often connected to the generator through an external umbilical. With the increasing deployment of lightweight and collaborative robots, the dynamic influence of this umbilical can significantly affect the robot motion and the actuation forces. This paper proposes a constrained multibody dynamic model of a welding umbilical, represented as a serial chain of rigid bodies interconnected by passive joints with elastic and dissipative effects. Prescribed motions at the distal anchor point are introduced through holonomic kinematic constraints. The equations of motion are reduced by projecting the dynamics onto the subspace of admissible velocities, yielding an efficient formulation free of Lagrange multipliers. The reaction wrench exerted by the umbilical on the robot is explicitly recovered. A planar case study illustrates the approach.
summary_zh: 机器人焊接在工业制造中应用广泛，场景中焊枪通常通过外部缆管与发生器相连。随着轻量化与协作机器人的普及部署，该缆管的动力学影响会显著改变机器人的运动与驱动力。本文提出一种焊接缆管的约束多体动力学模型，将缆管表示为由被动关节连接的刚体串联链，被动关节具备弹性与耗散效应。通过完整运动学约束引入远端锚点的指定运动。通过将动力学投影到容许速度子空间对运动方程进行降阶，得到不含拉格朗日乘子的高效公式，可显式求解缆管作用于机器人的反作用力矩。本文通过平面案例研究验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Transient multimode heat transfer of an industrial automated tape laying process under rapidly changing conditions
title_zh: 快速变化工况下工业自动铺带（ATL）过程的瞬态多模式传热特性研究
authors: Bernhard Rameder, Hubert Gattringer, Andreas Müller, Ronald Naderer
abstract: This work presents a transient heat-transfer model of an industrial automated tape laying (ATL) process designed to overcome the limitations of conventional thermal models in composite manufacturing. The model solves the heat-conduction equation with coupled advection, conduction, convection, and radiation. A key innovation is the implementation of an analytical view factor approach that accounts for finite emitter and tape widths, thereby correcting systematic overestimations of radiative heat flux inherent in 1.5D simplifications. Furthermore, a local convection assessment incorporates mixed convection effects characterized by the Richardson number, ensuring accuracy across a wide range of process speeds. The ATL system is represented by two interacting subsystems: the moving tape substrate and the infrared heat sources. The tape is discretized using a two-node model that resolves the physical phase shift between the heated and monitored surfaces. Numerical stability under high dynamics is ensured by a monolithic solution strategy using a high-order implicit integration scheme. Model predictions were validated on an industrial ATL line, demonstrating an overall deviation of only 1.08% (NRMSE) under rapid velocity and current modulations. This framework provides a high-fidelity, physics-based foundation for thermal state estimation, supporting consistent in-situ consolidation and improved part quality.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种工业自动铺带（ATL）过程的瞬态传热模型，旨在克服复合材料制造领域传统热模型的局限性。该模型求解耦合了平流、传导、对流与辐射效应的热传导方程。核心创新点在于实现了解析视角因子方法，可考虑有限辐射器与铺带宽度，修正了1.5D简化方法中固有的辐射热流系统性高估问题。此外，局部对流评估纳入了以理查森数为特征的混合对流效应，可在宽工艺速度范围内保证精度。ATL系统由两个交互子系统构成：移动铺带基底与红外热源。铺带采用双节点模型离散化，可分辨加热表面与监测表面之间的物理相位差。采用高阶隐式积分方案的整体求解策略保证了高动态工况下的数值稳定性。所提模型的预测结果在工业ATL生产线上完成验证，在速度与电流快速调制场景下的整体归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）仅为1.08%。该框架为热状态估计提供了高保真的物理基础，可支撑一致的原位固结工艺，提升零件质量。

title: Towards safe and optimal flight: Viability Kernel MPC for Fully Actuated Multirotor
title_zh: 面向安全最优飞行：全驱动多旋翼飞行器的可行域核模型预测控制（MPC）方法
authors: Massimiliano Bertoni, Alberto Piccina, Gianni Lunardi, Elias Fontanari, Andrea Del Prete 等 (7 人)
abstract: Industrial aerial robotics demands safety guarantees for navigation in unstructured environments while optimizing performance and computational efficiency. This paper presents a method for generating safe pose trajectories for fully actuated multirotors within a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework, leveraging both viability theory and data-driven methods. Obstacle avoidance is enforced through dynamically computed axis-aligned bounding boxes, providing formal safety guarantees without exhaustive offline reachability analysis. Numerical simulations on a fully actuated tilted hexarotor validate the approach, demonstrating successful navigation in cluttered environments with real-time computational performance.
summary_zh: 工业级空中机器人要求在非结构化环境中导航时具备安全保障，同时兼顾性能与计算效率。本文提出一种在模型预测控制（MPC）框架内为全驱动多旋翼生成安全位姿轨迹的方法，融合了可行域理论与数据驱动方法。该方法通过动态计算轴对齐包围盒实现避障，无需开展详尽的离线可达性分析即可提供正式安全保障。针对全驱动倾转六旋翼的数值仿真验证了该方法的有效性，结果表明其可在密集障碍物环境中实现导航，且具备实时计算性能。

title: SUPER ODOMETRY 2.0: Resilient Odometry via Hierarchical Adaptation
title_zh: 超级里程计2.0：基于层级自适应的弹性里程计框架
authors: Shibo Zhao, Sifan Zhou, Yuchen Zhang, Ji Zhang, Chen Wang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Resilient and robust odometry is crucial for autonomous systems operating in complex and dynamic environments. Existing odometry systems often struggle with severe sensory degradations and extreme conditions such as smoke, sandstorms, snow, or low-light conditions, threatening both the safety and functionality of robots. To address these challenges, we present Super Odometry, a sensor fusion framework that dynamically adapts to varying levels of environmental degradation. Super Odometry employs a hierarchical structure to integrate four core modules from lower-level to higher-level adaptability including adaptive feature selection, adaptive state direction selection, adaptive engine selection, and a novel learning- based inertial odometry. The inertial odometry, trained on over 100 hours of heterogeneous robotic platforms, captures comprehensive motion dynamics. Super Odometry elevates the inertial measurement unit (IMU) to equal importance with camera and LiDAR within the sensor fusion framework, providing a reliable fallback when exteroceptive sensors fail. Super Odometry has been validated across 200 kilometers and 800 operational hours on a fleet of aerial, wheeled, and legged robots, under diverse sensor configurations, environmental degradation, and aggressive motion profiles. It marks an important step towards safe and long-term robotic autonomy in all-degraded environments.
summary_zh: 弹性鲁棒的里程计技术是复杂动态环境下自主系统运行的核心支撑。现有里程计系统通常难以应对严重的传感器退化与极端工况，例如烟雾、沙尘暴、降雪或低光照场景，威胁机器人的安全与功能可靠性。为应对上述挑战，本文提出超级里程计，一种可动态适配不同程度环境退化的传感器融合框架。超级里程计采用层级结构集成四大核心模块，从低到高分别对应不同自适应等级：自适应特征选择、自适应状态方向选择、自适应引擎选择与新型基于学习的惯性里程计。该惯性里程计在超过100小时的异构机器人平台数据上训练，可捕捉全面的运动动力学特性。超级里程计将惯性测量单元（IMU）提升至与相机、激光雷达同等重要的地位，在外部感知传感器失效时提供可靠的降级运行方案。超级里程计已在200公里行程、800小时运行时长的空中、轮式与足式机器人群组上完成验证，覆盖多样化传感器配置、环境退化场景与激进运动剖面，为全退化环境下的机器人长期安全自主运行迈出了重要一步。

title: LAC: Linear and Angular Compliance for Humanoid Whole-body Control
title_zh: LAC：面向人形机器人全身控制的线角柔顺性方法
authors: Yang Liu, Zhongkai Gu, Wei Zhu, Mitsuhiro Hayashibe
abstract: Real-world humanoid tasks involve physical interaction with objects and humans, yet current controllers either reject external forces as disturbances or restrict compliance to limited body links while ignoring angular effects. We present LAC, a general whole-body controller that simultaneously realizes commanded Linear and Angular Compliance for wrenches applied to the upper body. First, we synthesize whole-body compliant responses into a large-scale augmented dataset. Sampled force and couple events are imposed on contact frames extracted from human interaction data. At each contact link, the external force and a virtual torque from the passively yielding kinematic chain drive a virtual admittance under the commanded stiffness. Subsequently, teacher-student reinforcement learning trains a single policy to track the compliant motions under external wrenches. Finally, extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate whole-body compliant responses to wrenches across the upper body, monotonic modulation over the full range of both stiffness commands, and applicability to teleoperated loco-manipulation tasks. Project website:this https URL
summary_zh: 现实世界中的人形机器人任务涉及与物体和人类的物理交互，但现有控制器要么将外力作为扰动进行抑制，要么将柔顺性限制在少量身体连杆上，忽略了力矩效应。本文提出LAC，一种通用全身控制器，可同时实现针对作用于上身的力旋量的指令化线柔顺与角柔顺。首先，我们将全身柔顺响应整合为大规模增广数据集，从人类交互数据中提取接触坐标系，在其上施加采样得到的力与力偶事件。在每个接触连杆处，外力与被动柔顺运动链产生的虚拟力矩会在指令刚度下驱动虚拟导纳。随后，采用师生强化学习训练单一策略，跟踪外力旋量作用下的柔顺运动。最终，大量仿真与真实场景实验证明，该控制器可实现上身所有区域对外力旋量的全身柔顺响应，可在全刚度指令范围内实现单调调节，适用于遥操作移动-操作一体化任务。项目主页见对应链接。

title: A Taxonomy of Construction Task Activities for Robot Workers
title_zh: 面向建筑作业机器人的施工任务活动分类体系
authors: Sadman Sakib, Zhangyi None Peng, Yujie Pang, Yu Otsuki, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque
abstract: Recent vision-language-action models offer a path toward robots with broader repertoires than conventional task-specific systems. Construction deployment, however, requires a precise inventory of worker activities and the capabilities needed to execute them. We present TARCAT, an occupation-grounded taxonomy derived from 91 O*NET tasks across seven high-employment construction occupations and 30 instructional videos of physical work. TARCAT defines 41 action primitives in 12 groups and three classes and provides a mechanism for composing parameterized primitive sequences into reusable skills. This human-interpretable structure can organize demonstrations, specify robot requirements, and support coding agents that retrieve and extend skill libraries. We also demonstrate selected primitives on a DOBOT CR3 arm with a CRAFT hand. TARCAT thereby provides a common vocabulary for analyzing human work and developing general-purpose construction robots. Annotations are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 近期涌现的视觉-语言-动作模型为开发比传统任务专用系统能力更广泛的机器人提供了可行路径。但建筑场景部署需要精准梳理工人的活动清单以及执行这些活动所需的能力。本文提出TARCAT，一种基于职业场景的分类体系，其构建基于7类高就业建筑职业对应的91项O*NET任务与30段体力操作教学视频。TARCAT定义了分属12个组、3个类别的41个动作原语，提供了可将参数化原语序列组合为可复用技能的机制。该人类可解释的结构可用于组织演示数据、明确机器人能力需求，支撑检索与扩展技能库的智能体开发。我们还在搭载CRAFT机械手的DOBOT CR3机械臂上对选定原语进行了验证。TARCAT为分析人类作业、开发通用建筑机器人提供了统一的术语体系。标注数据可通过对应链接获取。

title: RAEM: Robust Autonomous Exploration for Multi-Floor Environments with a Quadruped Robot
title_zh: RAEM：面向四足机器人的多层环境鲁棒自主探索方法
authors: Zikang Yuan, Yuan Ren, Yian Wang, Yixue Wang, Enze Fang 等 (13 人)
abstract: In this paper, we propose RAEM, a robust autonomous exploration framework for quadruped robots operating in multi-floor environments. Most existing ground-robot exploration approaches rely on planar traversability representations, which cannot adequately represent the overlapping structures and cross-floor connectivity of multi-floor buildings. Although tomography-based representations provide effective traversability modeling for multi-floor navigation, maintaining a global tomography map incurs substantial computational overhead for online exploration with frequent replanning. Moreover, sparse and fragmented LiDAR observations in stairwells can degrade local traversability estimation, leading to irregular viewpoint placement and temporary topological disconnections. To address these challenges, RAEM adopts a hybrid local-global traversability representation, in which a local tomography map and an explicitly categorized local 3D grid map are used for online terrain analysis and connectivity evaluation, while an elevation-aware global topological graph is incrementally constructed from these local spatial representations for efficient cross-floor exploration planning. We further introduce a staircase center alignment strategy to reduce abrupt yaw variations during climbing and a dual path searching mechanism to recover guidance paths when the global topology is locally disconnected. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate robust and computationally stable autonomous exploration across multi-floor structures, including continuous exploration of a five-floor stairwell.
summary_zh: 本文提出RAEM，一种面向在多层环境中运行的四足机器人的鲁棒自主探索框架。现有大多数地面机器人探索方法依赖平面可通行性表示，无法充分表征多层建筑的重叠结构与跨楼层连通性。尽管基于断层扫描的表示可为多层导航提供有效的可通行性建模，但维护全局断层扫描地图会给需要频繁重规划的在线探索带来巨大计算开销。此外，楼梯间稀疏碎片化的激光雷达观测会降低局部可通行性估计精度，导致视点放置不规律、拓扑结构临时断开等问题。为解决上述挑战，RAEM采用局部-全局混合可通行性表示：其中局部断层扫描地图与显式分类的局部3D网格地图用于在线地形分析与连通性评估，而具备高程感知能力的全局拓扑图从这些局部空间表示中增量构建，用于实现高效的跨楼层探索规划。本文进一步提出楼梯中心对齐策略，减少爬楼过程中的偏航突变，以及双路径搜索机制，用于在全局拓扑局部断开时恢复引导路径。大量仿真与真实场景实验验证了该方法可实现跨多层结构的鲁棒、计算稳定的自主探索，包括对五层楼梯间的连续探索。

title: Beyond Pairwise Feedback: Listwise Vision-Language Supervision for Preference-Based Reward Learning
title_zh: 超越成对反馈：面向基于偏好奖励学习的列表级视觉语言监督
authors: Srivalli Katkuri, Maxwell Kawada, Juan Wachs
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful source of supervision for reinforcement learning, enabling agents to leverage rich semantic knowledge during training. Inspired by the success of preference-based reward learning (PbRL) in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), vision-language model generated image-based preferences provide an effective source for learning reward functions. This can be done by visually comparing two outcomes through the Bradley-Terry (BT) model. However, this pairwise formulation utilizes only two observations at a time, despite VLMs being capable of ranking multiple candidates. The Plackett-Luce (PL) formulation can shape a reward model with listwise rankings as opposed to pairwise preferences, allowing for a more suited use of a VLM based ranking. In this work, to our knowledge, we introduce the first framework that combines VLM-generated preferences with the Plackett-Luce model for reward learning. We evaluate our approach on Meta-World manipulation tasks and show that Plackett-Luce (PL) reward models can train robotic policies from VLM-generated rankings as effectively as pairwise Bradley-Terry, $K$-wise Bradley-Terry, and RL-VLM-F baselines. Across all environments, at least one PL ranking size ($K \in \{3,4,5\}$) consistently performs with or outperforms other methods in mean success rate. Unlike pairwise methods, which are restricted to $K=2$, PL supports different ranking sizes and can therefore be adapted to the environment and desired feedback format. Our best PL configuration achieves an 86% mean final success rate and matches the Oracle baseline on Drawer Open. Overall, these results demonstrate that listwise VLM preference supervision is a competitive and flexible approach to reward learning for reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已成为强化学习领域极具潜力的监督来源，可让智能体在训练过程中利用丰富的语义知识。受人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中基于偏好的奖励学习（PbRL）的成功启发，由视觉语言模型生成的基于图像的偏好为奖励函数学习提供了有效路径，这类方法通常通过Bradley-Terry（BT）模型对两个输出结果进行视觉比较实现。但这种成对模式一次仅能利用两个观测值，而实际上VLM具备对多个候选结果排序的能力。Plackett-Luce（PL）模式可基于列表级排序而非成对偏好构建奖励模型，能够更充分地利用VLM的排序能力。据我们所知，本研究首次提出将VLM生成的偏好与Plackett-Luce模型相结合用于奖励学习的框架。我们在Meta-World操作任务上对所提方法进行评估，结果表明Plackett-Luce（PL）奖励模型可基于VLM生成的排序训练机器人策略，效果与成对Bradley-Terry、K-近邻Bradley-Terry、RL-VLM-F等基线方法相当。在所有测试环境中，至少一种PL排序规模（K∈{3,4,5}）的平均成功率始终与其他方法持平甚至更优。与仅支持K=2的成对方法不同，PL支持不同的排序规模，可适配不同环境与期望反馈格式。最优PL配置的平均最终成功率达86%，在抽屉开启任务上与Oracle基线性能持平。上述结果表明，列表级VLM偏好监督是一种具备竞争力、灵活性强的强化学习奖励学习方法。

title: SonicNudge: Controlled Displacement of Hovering UAVs via Estimator-Controller Coupling
title_zh: SonicNudge：基于估计器-控制器耦合的悬停无人机可控位移攻击
authors: Shaocheng Luo, Ashir Raza, Haocheng Meng, David Hunt, Miroslav Pajic
abstract: UAV displacement attacks have traditionally relied on spoofing sensors that directly report position or translational motion, such as GNSS and optical flow. In this work, we introduce SonicNudge, a new attack primitive that instead targets the gyroscope and shows that low-level inertial errors can be transformed into controlled displacement of hovering or slow-moving UAVs. The attack exploits estimator--controller coupling: a small gyroscope perturbation by ultrasonic resonance can persist as an attitude-estimation bias, and the flight controller can convert this biased estimate into a shifted hover point. This behavior is especially relevant to UAV tasks that require hovering, station-keeping, slow approach, or precise final alignment, such as perimeter denial, inspection, docking, landing alignment, and close-proximity operation, where meter-scale position errors can be operationally meaningful. We analyze this attack primitive in a PX4-style flight stack and validate it through 81 simulation runs and more than 10 indoor/outdoor physical experiments, showing that displacement is governed by estimator weighting, bias observability, and closed-loop position correction. Our study suggests that UAV and vehicle-system security should look beyond direct navigation spoofing and pay closer attention to low-level inertial errors and estimator--controller coupling as a subtle but important attack surface.
summary_zh: 传统无人机位移攻击通常依赖于对直接上报位置或平移运动的传感器进行欺骗，例如全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）与光流传感器。本研究提出SonicNudge，一种全新的攻击原语，其攻击目标为陀螺仪，可将底层惯性误差转化为对悬停或低速运动无人机的可控位移。该攻击利用估计器-控制器耦合特性：通过超声共振产生的微小陀螺仪扰动可持续存在为姿态估计偏差，飞行控制器可将该偏差估计转化为偏移后的悬停点。该攻击行为对需要执行悬停、驻留、低速接近或精确最终对齐任务的无人机影响尤为显著，例如周界防御、巡检、对接、着陆对齐、近距操作等场景，米级位置误差即可造成重大运行影响。我们在PX4风格飞行栈上对该攻击原语进行分析，通过81次仿真运行与超过8次室内外实体实验完成验证，结果表明位移量由估计器权重、偏差可观测性与闭环位置校正共同决定。本研究表明，无人机与车辆系统安全研究不应仅局限于直接导航欺骗，还需重点关注底层惯性误差与估计器-控制器耦合这类隐蔽但关键的攻击面。

title: Generative Action-Chunk Sampling for Adaptive Stiffness Control in Physical Human-Robot Collaboration
title_zh: 面向物理人机协作自适应刚度控制的生成式动作块采样方法
authors: Aoi Otake, Ferdinand Hartmann, Ko Igari, Shingo Murata
abstract: Physical human-robot collaboration requires a robot to provide assistance when human intention is clear while remaining compliant when several future motions are plausible. We present an adaptive stiffness framework based on generative action-chunk sampling. Conditioned on an RGB image and external joint-torque estimates, the policy samples multiple future action chunks from an observation-conditioned prior. Variation among the sampled action chunks is used to continuously adapt joint stiffness and damping. Greater variation makes the robot more compliant to facilitate human guidance, whereas lower variation provides firmer assistance. In a real-world collaborative transport task with four possible directions, the proposed method achieved an average success rate of 0.95, compared with 0.83 for a fixed-stiffness ablation and 0.69 for a deterministic baseline. Near direction determination, variation among the sampled action chunks increased and the controller accordingly reduced stiffness. These results suggest that variation among actions sampled by a generative policy can serve as an online control signal for balancing assistance and compliance in physical human-robot interaction.
summary_zh: 物理人机协作要求机器人在人类意图明确时提供辅助，而在未来存在多种可能运动时保持柔顺性。本文提出一种基于生成式动作块采样的自适应刚度框架。以RGB图像与外部关节力矩估计为条件，该策略从观测条件先验中采样多个未来动作块，利用采样动作块之间的差异持续调整关节刚度与阻尼：差异越大，机器人越柔顺，便于人类引导；差异越小，机器人提供的辅助越稳固。在包含4个可能方向的真实协作运输任务中，所提方法的平均成功率达0.95，优于固定刚度消融实验的0.83与确定性基线的0.69。在接近方向确定时，采样动作块之间的差异增大，控制器相应降低刚度。上述结果表明，生成式策略采样得到的动作之间的差异可作为在线控制信号，用于平衡物理人机交互中的辅助性与柔顺性。

title: PhaseShift: Topology-Aware Data Harmonization and Model Consolidation Across Signalized Intersections
title_zh: PhaseShift：面向信号控制交叉口的拓扑感知数据统一与模型整合框架
authors: Yash Ranjan, Artur Kumik, Rahul Sengupta, Anand Rangarajan, Sanjay Ranka
abstract: Learned traffic-behavior models are commonly trained separately for each intersection, creating model portfolios that cannot share evidence across sites. We present PhaseShift, a topology-aware framework that harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared actor-centric representation and trains one reusable backbone. Ego-relative coordinates, trajectory-induced movement paths, normalized signal context, and variable-cardinality interaction tokens remove site conventions while preserving behaviorally relevant topology. The backbone supports pooled operation, zero-shot at a held-out intersection, and low-data adaptation. We evaluate five intersections in two Florida regions on balanced field data, 100k training windows and equal-sized test sets per site under a replay-conditioned, best-of-sampled-trajectory protocol. At 10s, one pooled model lowers both minADE and minFDE relative to trained local models at all five sites, with median reductions of 36.8% and 22.0%. Leave-one-intersection-out deployment, including one cross-region fold, beats local training on both 10-s metrics at four of five sites, although short-horizon performance is less uniform. Fine-tuning with 1,000 target update windows improves on zero-shot at three sites and is the strongest regime at one. At site 7, every cross-site mixture sharply lowers long-horizon error under a fixed 100k-window budget; test-likelihood gains argue against a best-of-sample dispersion-only explanation. Local models fall behind calibrated IDM at the two highest-flow sites after long autoregressive rollouts; pretrained-backbone regimes do not. Within this five-site evaluation, PhaseShift demonstrates consolidation across heterogeneous physical control settings while identifying sites that still require adaptation. The protocol measures conditional single-vehicle generation under replayed context, not closed-loop traffic simulation.
summary_zh: 现有学习得到的交通行为模型通常针对每个交叉口单独训练，形成的模型集合无法跨站点共享数据信息。本文提出PhaseShift，一种拓扑感知框架，可将异质的路侧轨迹统一为共享的以参与者为中心的表示，训练得到一个可复用的主干网络。自车相对坐标、轨迹诱导运动路径、归一化信号上下文与可变基数交互令牌可消除站点特有约定，同时保留与行为相关的拓扑信息。该主干网络支持联合训练运行、在未见过的交叉口上的零样本部署，以及小数据适配。我们在佛罗里达州两个地区的5个交叉口上，基于均衡现场数据、10万个训练窗口与每个站点等规模的测试集，在重放条件下采样最优轨迹的协议下开展评估。在10秒预测时长下，与各站点单独训练的本地模型相比，联合训练得到的单个模型在所有5个站点上均降低了平均位移误差（minADE）与最终位移误差（minFDE），中位降幅分别达36.8%与22.0%。留一交叉口部署（含一个跨区域分组）在5个站点中的4个站点上的10秒指标表现优于本地训练，尽管短时长性能的一致性稍弱。使用1000个目标更新窗口进行微调后，在3个站点上的表现优于零样本部署，在1个站点上性能最优。在7号站点，在固定10万窗口预算下，所有跨站点混合方案均大幅降低了长时长预测误差；测试似然度的提升表明该性能无法仅用采样最优样本的分散性解释。在长自回归推演后，两个流量最高站点的本地模型性能低于经过校准的智能驾驶员模型（IDM），而预训练主干网络方案未出现该问题。在本次5站点评估中，PhaseShift实现了异质物理控制场景下的模型整合，同时识别出仍需适配的站点。该评估协议测量的是重放上下文条件下的单车辆生成性能，而非闭环交通仿真性能。

title: Development of a Voice-Controlled Tendon-Driven Bionic Hand
title_zh: 语音控制的腱驱动仿生手开发
authors: Urja Kohli, Shagata Chanda, Kritika Gandhi, Charu Nigam, Aditi Surya Kamal 等 (6 人)
abstract: The impairment of the hands can seriously affect the abilities of every individual to perform the every-day activity, so the design of stable and controllable support devices is a significant field of study. This paper is about the design and implementation of an automated bionic hand which is dedicated to the coordinated finger movement through the simplified and efficient actuation mechanism. The method that the proposed system was designed on is the tendon-based method whereby the servo motors generate the movement of the fingers, with assistance of the angular control which is calibrated. An actuation is controlled by a microcontroller that will be programmed by use of an Arduino-based microcontroller to carry out programmed gestures that include open hand, fist, pinch and half flexion. It has an interface that is voice command enabled to make it easy to interact with a Bluetooth based sender receiver architecture which offers an option of executing trained commands which are immediately converted to finger actions. To explore the motions behavior, finger coordination and control response to the input, the behavior of the experiment system is tested. The actuation of the fingers was found to take a total of about 7-8 seconds to achieve full flexion of all fingers in a sequence. The system showed repetitive and constant motion throughout several actuation cycles without loss of any apparent tension or precision of control. There was a stable grasp of objects of different shapes and sizes, which implied consistent coordination between the fingers. These findings indicate that the proposed system offers predictable and steady control behavior and has a simple and efficient mechanical and control architecture.
summary_zh: 手部功能障碍会严重影响个体完成日常活动的能力，因此设计稳定可控的辅助设备是重要的研究方向。本文介绍一款自动化仿生手的设计与实现，该设备通过简化高效的驱动机构实现手指协同运动。该系统采用基于腱驱动的设计方法，由伺服电机在经过校准的角度控制辅助下产生手指运动。驱动单元由基于Arduino的微控制器控制，可执行预设手势，包括张手、握拳、捏取与半屈曲。该系统配备语音命令交互界面，可与基于蓝牙的收发架构便捷交互，支持执行训练完成的命令并立即转化为手指动作。为探究运动特性、手指协同性与控制响应性能，我们对实验系统进行测试。结果显示，所有手指依次完成全屈曲的总时长约为7-8秒。系统在多次驱动循环中运动重复稳定，未出现明显张力损失或控制精度下降，可稳定抓取不同形状与尺寸的物体，表明手指间协同性良好。上述结果表明，所提系统具备可预测的稳定控制性能，拥有简洁高效的机械与控制架构。

title: Longitudinal Robot Learning from Demonstration with Care Providers in a Home Environment
title_zh: 家庭环境下与护理人员协同的纵向机器人示教学习方法
authors: Nina Moorman, Julianna Schalkwyk, Vriksha Srihari, Qingyu Xiao, Kamel Alrashedy 等 (9 人)
abstract: Learning from demonstration (LfD) methods enable non-expert end users to teach robots novel skills without explicit programming. However most evaluations of the usability of LfD with non-experts has been conducted in controlled laboratory environments with a robotics experimenter present. In this work we identify non-expert end users' key barriers when teaching robots via demonstration without live robotics expert feedback in a home environment. In our human subjects experiment we support the non-expert end users through two forms of demonstrator guidance developed in prior work: pre-training and adaptive feedback. Towards the ecological validity of the evaluation, we conduct this experimentation over multiple visits, with a population of care providers. Finally, we propose to open source the resulting LfD dataset of care providers teaching a robot assistive tasks over multiple visits to a home environment.
summary_zh: 示教学习（LfD）方法可让非专业终端用户无需显式编程即可教会机器人新技能。但目前大多数针对非专业用户示教学习可用性的评估都是在有机器人实验人员在场的受控实验室环境下开展的。本研究明确了非专业终端用户在家庭环境中、无现场机器人专家反馈的情况下通过示教教会机器人技能时面临的核心障碍。在人类受试者实验中，我们通过前期工作开发的两种示教者引导形式（预训练与自适应反馈）为非专业终端用户提供支持。为保障评估的生态效度，我们面向护理人员群体开展了多次随访实验。最终我们将开源本次实验得到的示教学习数据集，该数据集记录了护理人员在多次家庭环境随访中教会机器人完成辅助任务的全过程。

title: CRESSim-Neo: A Batched GPU Simulation Engine for Surgical Robotics and Robot Learning
title_zh: CRESSim-Neo：面向手术机器人与机器人学习的批处理GPU仿真引擎
authors: Yafei Ou, Ahnaf Naheen, Tleukhan Mussin, Hans Jarales, Melwin Moncy 等 (6 人)
abstract: We introduce CRESSim-Neo, a batched GPU simulation engine for surgical robotics and robot learning. CRESSim-Neo combines position-based simulation of rigid bodies, deformable tissues, fluids, and strands with batched rendering, surgery-specific sensing, and a GPU-resident data pipeline. The engine supports applications including tissue manipulation, fluid suction, suturing, cable-driven robots, and ultrasound image synthesis. Direct access to physics and rendering buffers enables GPU-resident robot learning and zero-copy PyTorch integration using DLPack. We demonstrate CRESSim-Neo across rigid-body, deformable-body, and fluid simulation tasks, including vision-based and surgical robot-learning scenarios. On an NVIDIA RTX 4090, the engine achieves up to 2.03 million environment steps per second for 8192 parallel CartPole environments, and scales to batched surgical scenarios involving tissue deformation, fluid interaction, and ultrasound sensing. Overall, CRESSim-Neo provides a unified and scalable platform for surgical simulation, synthetic data generation, and surgical robot learning.
summary_zh: 本文提出CRESSim-Neo，一款面向手术机器人与机器人学习的批处理GPU仿真引擎。CRESSim-Neo融合了基于位置的刚体、可变形组织、流体与线状物仿真能力，集成批渲染、手术专属传感与GPU驻留数据流水线。该引擎支持组织操作、流体抽吸、缝合、缆驱动机器人与超声图像合成等应用场景。通过直接访问物理与渲染缓冲区，可实现GPU驻留机器人学习，以及基于DLPack的零拷贝PyTorch集成。我们在刚体、可变形体与流体仿真任务，包括视觉辅助与手术机器人学习场景下对CRESSim-Neo进行验证。在NVIDIA RTX 4090显卡上，该引擎针对8192个并行CartPole环境可实现每秒最高203万个环境步，可扩展至包含组织变形、流体交互与超声传感的批处理手术场景。总体而言，CRESSim-Neo为手术仿真、合成数据生成与手术机器人学习提供了统一且可扩展的平台。

title: Control-Oriented Learning for Dynamic Tracking and Stability Analysis of Soft Pneumatic Actuators
title_zh: 面向动态跟踪与稳定性分析的软体气动执行器控制导向学习方法
authors: Nithin S. Kumar, Eric J. Barth
abstract: Soft pneumatic actuators offer inherent compliance and safe interaction but remain difficult to model and control because of their highly nonlinear, distributed dynamics. We present a control-oriented data-driven modeling and control framework that decomposes actuator behavior into a nonlinear static equilibrium model and a linear residual dynamics model identified using Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition with control (EDMDc). This representation enables feedforward compensation, task-space feedback control, and local closed-loop stability analysis through an augmented linear model. Experiments achieve approximately 1 mm root mean square error (RMSE) during low-speed (approximately 10 mm/s) trajectory tracking and below 10 mm RMSE at higher speeds (approximately 100 mm/s). The framework further achieves stable tracking of highly dynamic user-generated references with peak accelerations exceeding 25 m/s^2 while simultaneously performing real-time obstacle avoidance. Finally, the proposed stability analysis is experimentally validated by accurately predicting stable, marginal, and unstable operating regimes. These results demonstrate that structured, control-oriented learning provides an accurate and practical framework for soft actuator control.
summary_zh: 软体气动执行器具备固有柔顺性与安全交互特性，但由于其高度非线性的分布式动力学特性，建模与控制难度较大。本文提出一种面向控制的数据驱动建模与控制框架，将执行器行为分解为非线性静态平衡模型与使用带控制的扩展动态模式分解（EDMDc）识别得到的线性残差动力学模型。该表示方法可通过增广线性模型实现前馈补偿、任务空间反馈控制与局部闭环稳定性分析。实验结果显示，在低速（约10mm/s）轨迹跟踪场景下，该方法的均方根误差（RMSE）约为1mm，在高速（约100mm/s）场景下均方根误差低于10mm。该框架可对峰值加速度超过25m/s²的高动态用户生成参考轨迹实现稳定跟踪，同时完成实时避障。最后，所提稳定性分析方法通过准确预测稳定、临界与不稳定工作区间得到了实验验证。上述结果表明，结构化的面向控制学习可为软体执行器控制提供准确实用的框架。

title: Sequential Object Placement Optimization with Convex Decomposition
title_zh: 基于凸分解的序列物体放置优化方法
authors: Yuezhe Zhang, Xiangyu Lyu, Sohan Rudra, Davide Tateo, Georgia Chalvatzaki
abstract: Robotic object packing has been a core challenge for robotic deployment in logistics, industry, etc., due to the curse of dimensionality in combinatorial search and the difficulty of dealing with dynamic and contact constraints for irregularly shaped objects. Current heuristic and learning-based methods assume a limited spatial discretization resolution of space, and computation becomes extremely inefficient as discretization accuracy increases. In this work, we eliminate these assumptions by introducing SOPO-CD, a sequential optimization framework that frames object placement as a differentiable nonlinear optimization problem in a decomposed free space. We prove that placing a convex object inside a convex hull is essentially constraining the vertices of the object inside the convex hull. The constraints and their derivatives can be written in closed form and calculated within $200$ns. We implement a custom solver that achieves optimal placement within tightly constrained space in milliseconds; a $100 \times$ speedup compared to a classical grid search method. We generalize our framework to 2D Tangram, 2D Tetris, and 3D Bin Packing, and have demonstrated strong computational performance and packing utility. We also demonstrate solving a real-world Tangram puzzle online using an Allegro Hand and an Xarm.
summary_zh: 机器人物体装箱是机器人在物流、工业等场景部署的核心挑战，其难点在于组合搜索的维度灾难，以及处理不规则物体动态约束与接触约束的难度。现有启发式与基于学习的方法均假设空间的空间离散化分辨率有限，随着离散化精度提升，计算效率会急剧下降。本研究打破上述假设，提出SOPO-CD，一种序列优化框架，将物体放置问题转化为分解后的自由空间中的可微非线性优化问题。我们证明，将凸物体放置在凸包内的本质约束是物体的所有顶点均位于凸包内，该约束及其导数可写成闭式形式，计算耗时低于200ns。我们实现了自定义求解器，可在毫秒级的时间内完成严格约束空间内的最优放置，与经典网格搜索方法相比速度提升100倍。我们将该框架泛化到2D七巧板、2D俄罗斯方块与3D装箱问题，展现出优异的计算性能与装箱利用率。我们还使用Allegro灵巧手与Xarm机械臂完成了真实场景下七巧板谜题的在线求解演示。

title: SkyDrive: Learning to Drive in a New City from Aerial Traffic Monitoring
title_zh: SkyDrive：基于空中交通监控的陌生城市场景自动驾驶学习
authors: Weijiang Xiong, Lan Feng, Alexandre Alahi, Nikolas Geroliminis
abstract: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress through imitation learning with massive human demonstration data. However, a trained planner often degrades severely when applied to a new environment zero-shot, because of domain shifts in traffic regulations, road layout and driving behaviors. Therefore, adapting a trajectory planner to a new city typically requires resource-demanding local data collection with a vehicle sensor suite. In this work, we show that driving behavior can be learned from a scalable and efficient alternative. We introduce \emph{SkyDrive}, a framework that utilizes drone-based traffic monitoring to provide efficient supervision for autonomous driving agents in a new environment. While vehicle-based data collection logs the ego and its surroundings, an aerial platform naturally observes many road users simultaneously over an extended field of view. As a result, every vehicle can be a data source with grounded driving behavior, effectively scaling up the amount of supervision. Based on 137 hours of aerial traffic monitoring footage, we extract 650K driving samples and construct a benchmark for trajectory planners and motion predictors. Zero-shot experiments with multiple models reveal significant cross-city domain gaps, but many of them can be alleviated by limited supervision from the sky, e.g., 30 minutes of monitoring per location. Our findings show that aerial traffic monitoring is an efficient and scalable data source for adapting autonomous driving systems in new cities. Data and code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 借助海量人类演示数据的模仿学习，自动驾驶技术已取得显著进展。然而受交通规则、道路布局与驾驶行为的域偏移影响，训练完成的规划器在零样本部署到全新环境时性能通常会出现严重退化。因此，将轨迹规划器适配到新城市场景，通常需要借助车载传感器套件采集资源成本极高的本地数据。本研究提出了一种可扩展、高效率的替代方案来学习驾驶行为：我们设计了SkyDrive框架，利用无人机交通监控为新环境中的自动驾驶智能体提供高效监督。车载数据采集方案仅能记录自车及其周边信息，而空中平台可在更大视野范围内同时观测大量道路参与者，使得每一辆车都能成为具备真实驾驶行为标注的数据源，有效扩大监督数据规模。基于137小时的空中交通监控视频，我们提取了65万条驾驶样本，构建了面向轨迹规划器与运动预测器的基准数据集。多模型零样本实验结果显示，不同城市间存在显著的域差距，但仅需少量空中监督（例如每个地点30分钟的监控数据）即可大幅缓解该问题。研究结果表明，空中交通监控是面向新城市场景自动驾驶系统适配的高效、可扩展数据源，相关数据与代码将对外公开。

title: Extending Ground-Constraint LiDAR-IMU Calibration to Tilted Surfaces in a Continuous-Time Framework
title_zh: 连续时间框架下将地面约束LiDAR-IMU（激光雷达-惯性测量单元）标定方法扩展至倾斜表面场景
authors: Vassili Korotkine, Pierre Chamoun, Mohammed Ayman Shalaby, James Richard Forbes
abstract: This paper presents a novel method that extends targetless LiDAR-IMU calibration for ground vehicles to non- flat environments.
